visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a medical setting with clinical lighting. A doctor, wearing a light blue professional shirt, a white surgical mask, and glasses with a head-mounted magnifier and LED light, is focused on a patient's face. The patient lies horizontally, with their face covered in a thick, light blue treatment paste. The doctor’s hands, clad in white latex gloves, move precisely near the patient's forehead, holding a clear medical tube. (2) As the procedure continues, the camera remains in a steady close-up shot of the patient's face and the doctor's active hands. The doctor uses a small medical swab to gently manipulate the blue substance on the patient's skin. Yellow Traditional Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen, transcribing the doctor's explanation. The background shows a portion of the clinic's interior, including clinical equipment and wall panels. (3) The doctor shifts their gaze slightly, continuing to monitor the treatment area through the magnifying lens. The lighting is bright and focused on the patient's face, highlighting the texture of the blue mask. The doctor's movements are calm and methodical. The logo of "DRX Dermatology Clinic" is visible in the upper-left corner of the frame throughout the session. (4) The video transitions to a clean, minimalist end screen. It features a light gray background with the "DRX" logo and the full name "美上美皮膚科診所" and "DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC" in dark text. Detailed contact information, including a Line ID, phone number, and two physical addresses in Sanchong and Zhongshan districts, is displayed alongside a "contact us" call to action.
